audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart read Karma, Karma, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill — shifted two rows off both packet.levelChart and the content win[] row, which agree on Skill, Skill, Karma, Karma, Malzahar, Malzahar, Malzahar.
audit.why: Levels 1-2 are genuinely even: Karma's Inner Flame poke against a Malefic Visions shove. Mantra is available from level 1 but only becomes lane-deciding once she can chain empowered Q poke at 3-5, which out-ranges Malzahar's 650 E. From 6 the lane flips permanently — Nether Grasp is point-and-click and Inspire's move speed is her only mobility.
audit.corrected: Full-layer rows realigned to Skill, Skill, Karma, Karma, Malzahar, Malzahar, Malzahar with whys rewritten on the two rows whose verdict changed direction. Content win[] already matched the packet, so no win[N] edits were proposed.

audit.why: Spike ordering as written is right: Karma's window is Mantra-Q at 3-5, Malzahar's is level 6 and everything after. Mantra itself sits on 40/38/36/34s and her damaging spells reduce it via Gathering Fire, which is why her poke window is continuous rather than a single burst — that number is now in breakdown.cooldowns.
audit.corrected: phases[2].why and phases[3].why now state Karma's Mantra-Q spike as the reason those rows are hers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named a non-existent Malzahar passive, 'Iron Boundary', and contained no cooldown number. The decisive interaction — Karma cancelling the Nether Grasp channel with Focused Resolve or Mantra-W — was never stated anywhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Malzahar's passive is Void Shift. His R carries the channel flag ('interruptible — any CC cancels it'); Karma's W and R both carry hardCC. Focused Resolve is 12s at every rank at 675 range; Inner Flame 9/8/7/6/5s at 950; Mantra 40/38/36/34s at 1100; Nether Grasp 140/110/80s at 700.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with all four real cooldowns and the channel-cancel stated; 'Iron Boundary' removed and Void Shift used by name in loading, tradeBad and breakdown.feeding.

audit.whatIsWrong: Karma's Mantra-W self-heal was never answered with Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.why: Brief missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal: Karma sustains through chip damage via Focused Resolve, and Malefic Visions is pure chip damage, so anti-heal timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Folded into 'ahead': buy anti-heal against her Mantra-W self-heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flagged 'Void Shift-up' in content.mid as a probable wrong ability name.
audit.why: False positive. Void Shift is the correct name of Malzahar's passive; 'Void Shift-up' is the hyphenated phrase 'Void Shift up'. The real fabricated name in this matchup is 'Iron Boundary' in breakdown.cooldowns, which the suspectNames check did not catch.
audit.corrected: No edit to content.mid. 'Iron Boundary' removed instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twenty-one lint findings: sixteen misgendered fields calling Karma he/his/him, two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim), one unsupported magnitude in report[7], one cooldowns field with no digit.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists karma as female; the bled bullets contradicted their own titles.
audit.corrected: All fixed below; bled bodies replaced with content matching their titles.
